name: How long does a typical gas line installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical gas line installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a gas line installation can vary based on several factors, including the length of the new line, its complexity, the type of property, and the need for trenching or wall modifications. A simple installation for a single appliance might take a few hours, while more complex projects involving multiple appliances or longer runs could take a full day or even longer. This estimate typically includes the installation work and initial testing, but not the time for the local inspection, which is scheduled separately.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time varies, from a few hours for simple projects to a full day or more for complex ones, depending on scope and complexity.
